answer: A sybil-resistant economy can charge every new agent a refundable stake locked in a shared vault: to join, an agent deposits tokens that unlock only after a probation of verified useful work. Fake identities become expensive at scale, since each copy needs its own stake. A pulse of attestations from established peers checks the work is real, and misbehavior forfeits the deposit. Like a ferrous lock that opens only for the right key, the stake binds one identity to one economic cost, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes while honest agents earn theirs back.
